target_definition: Occurrence of drilling hazard (ANY_HAZARD) in upcoming (MD, MD + 100.0m]
interval_definition: 30.0-metre non-overlapping prediction points along wellbore trajectory
leakage_safeguards: Strict Leave-One-Well-Out fold splitting (zero wellbore overlap between train and validation)
Temporal/depth boundary enforcement (features computed strictly at MD <= prediction_md)
Offset hazard filtering strictly excludes active wellbore and excludes future relative depths
Rolling telemetry statistics window restricted to past 20m (sample_md <= prediction_md)
Target labels and post-event fields strictly excluded from feature space
Phase 4 rule engine alerts strictly segregated as comparison baseline, not ML inputs

features_documented.calculation: Canonical formation name resolved at prediction MD via formation tops interpolation.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Calculated strictly at prediction MD; does not inspect future formation tops.

features_documented.calculation: Distance in meters below the canonical formation top MD (MD - top_md).
features_documented.leakage_guard: Uses top MD of currently active formation at or above prediction point.

features_documented.calculation: Cumulative measured depth along the wellbore trajectory (30m discretization).
features_documented.leakage_guard: Current interval prediction point; prediction horizon is strictly (MD, MD + 100m].

features_documented.calculation: Count of historical events in offset wells in the same formation at relative depth <= current relative depth.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Strictly excludes events from the active wellbore and excludes future relative depths.

features_documented.calculation: Total historical events in offset wells in the same canonical formation across all drilled intervals.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Strictly aggregates offset wellbores only; active wellbore events are excluded.

features_documented.calculation: Binary indicator (0/1) if any offset wellbore previously encountered LOSS in this formation at <= relative depth.
Binary indicator (0/1) if any offset wellbore previously encountered KICK in this formation at <= relative depth.
Binary indicator (0/1) if any offset wellbore previously encountered STICKY_HOLE or STUCK_PIPE at <= relative depth.
Rolling mean Rate of Penetration (m/h) for previous 20m / samples at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Only averages telemetry samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

features_documented.calculation: Rolling mean surface torque (kN.m) for previous 20m / samples at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Only averages telemetry samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

features_documented.calculation: Rolling mean standpipe pressure (psi) for previous 20m / samples at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Only averages telemetry samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

features_documented.calculation: Rolling mean weight on bit (klbs) for previous 20m / samples at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Only averages telemetry samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

features_documented.calculation: Rolling mean mud flow in (L/min) for previous 20m / samples at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Only averages telemetry samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

features_documented.calculation: Rolling mean total hydrocarbon gas (%) for previous 20m / samples at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Only averages telemetry samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

features_documented.calculation: Active mud density (SG) recorded at or before prediction MD.
features_documented.leakage_guard: Strictly from samples where sample_md <= prediction_md. Missing telemetry is null.

baselines_evaluated: Phase 4 Deterministic K-of-N Offset Evidence Rule Engine
models_evaluated: Logistic Regression (L2 regularized, balanced class weight, LOWOCV)
ship_decision_reason: ML did not demonstrate sufficient improvement over the deterministic Phase 4 baseline on the available evaluation data.
operational_limitations: Volve is a public North Sea prototype dataset (Block 15/9) and is not evidence of equivalent event frequencies or model performance for Oil India operations.
Model trained strictly offline on 6 Volve wellbores; no real-time Oil India / eRTMAC telemetry or drilling events are included.
Deterministic Phase 4 K-of-N offset rule engine remains the primary operational baseline.
Predictions reflect cross-validated retrospective backtesting and must not be used as autonomous operational instructions.
